title: Alarms on the current guest: injected faults and held-out families on net1 v7
description: The alarms of experiments/r2_alarms.py were measured only on the old guest's net1 v6 (exp-r2-faults-210, exp-r2-alarms-81). This repeats both on net1 v7 (exp-net1v6-229, its chosen run) and the fixed guest. Faults: the fixed rule at u = 0.25 on net1 v7 with one of the seven LCFs' beliefs halved or doubled (rule_export.py --fault), fourteen policies and the rule unfaulted, each on the 21 validation links of the training family under its three conditions for 30 s (experiments/heldout.py, campaign seed 31), every 6th step kept. Held-out families: net1 v7's four held-out test sets (exp-data-net1-broad-ood-220: BBRv3 and Westwood competitors, 3% to 6% loss, 61 to 90 ms one-way delay, 8 to 16 BDP buffers). Thresholds at the 95th percentile on the validation links of net1 v7's 30 s training data (exp-data-net1-broad-30s-218, the same link split as net1 v7), false alarms on its test links. Reading, stated before the results: the old guest's claim carries over if, at those thresholds, every fault release 210 caught in 97% to 100% of the episodes wrong about it is caught in at least 90% here, and the ones it missed are named as misses again. alarms/summary.md has detection per alarm and LCF; impact/baselines.md what each fault does to the closed loop.
prepare: N1="$IN/n/$(cat "$IN/n/chosen.txt")/net1.pt"; test -f "$N1"; camp() { uv run python experiments/heldout.py "$OUT/spec-$1" --split val --family training --duration-ms 30000 --seed 31 --stock "" --policy "rule-$1=$OUT/policies/$1/rule-u0.25.onnx"; uv run expliccit campaign plan "$OUT/spec-$1/campaign.json" "$OUT/c-$1"; }; uv run python experiments/rule_export.py "$OUT/policies/none" "$N1" --u 0.25; camp none; for f in queue_delay_mean_ns:qdelay queue_pkts:queue capacity_bps:capacity free_buffer_pkts:freebuf busy_fraction:busy one_way_delay_ns:owd receive_rate_bps:receive; do l=${f%:*}; n=${f#*:}; for k in 0.5 2; do uv run python experiments/rule_export.py "$OUT/policies/$n-x$k" "$N1" --u 0.25 --fault "$l*$k"; camp "$n-x$k"; done; done; jq -s add "$OUT"/spec-*/aliases.json > "$OUT/aliases.json"
run: for c in "$OUT"/c-*; do uv run expliccit campaign run "$c" --shard "$SHARD/$SHARDS" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS" --tables steps --steps-stride 6; done
collect: N1="$IN/n/$(cat "$IN/n/chosen.txt")/net1.pt"; A=(--positives "none=$OUT/c-none"); for f in queue_delay_mean_ns:qdelay queue_pkts:queue capacity_bps:capacity free_buffer_pkts:freebuf busy_fraction:busy one_way_delay_ns:owd receive_rate_bps:receive; do l=${f%:*}; n=${f#*:}; for k in 0.5 2; do A+=(--positives "$n-x$k=$OUT/c-$n-x$k" --fault "$n-x$k=$l*$k"); done; done; for s in competitors loss rtt buffer; do A+=(--positives "ood-$s=$IN/ood/campaign-ood-$s"); done; uv run python experiments/r2_alarms.py "$OUT/alarms" --net1 v7="$N1" --calib "$IN/d30/campaign-train30" --negatives "$IN/d30/campaign-train30" "${A[@]}"; uv run python experiments/baselines_report.py "$OUT/impact" "$OUT"; rm -rf "$OUT/policies"/*/rule-u0.25-actor.pt
